nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿由 aₙ→L 的定义明确断言存在自然数 N₁，使 n≥N₁ 时 |aₙ−L|<ε/2
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM v_eps r_hL h_eps_pos
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < v_eps / 2 := by linarith
  have hev := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 r_hL) (v_eps / 2) hhalf
  rcases (Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hev) with ⟨v_N1_bind, hN⟩
  refine ⟨v_N1_bind, ?_⟩
  intro v_n_q1 hv
  have hd : dist (v_a v_n_q1) v_L < v_eps / 2 := hN v_n_q1 hv
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hd

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿由 aₙ→M 的定义明确断言存在自然数 N₂，使 n≥N₂ 时 |aₙ−M|<ε/2
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM v_eps r_hM h_eps_pos
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < v_eps / 2 := by linarith
  have hev := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 r_hM) (v_eps / 2) hhalf
  rcases (Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hev) with ⟨v_N2_bind, hN⟩
  refine ⟨v_N2_bind, ?_⟩
  intro v_n_q2 hv
  have hd : dist (v_a v_n_q2) v_M < v_eps / 2 := hN v_n_q2 hv
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hd

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿消去存在量词后使用 N₁ 的局部性质：n≥N₁ 时 |aₙ−L|<ε/2
原稿消去存在量词后使用 N₂ 的局部性质：n≥N₂ 时 |aₙ−M|<ε/2
原稿明确取 n=max(N₁,N₂) 后两个不等式同时成立
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM v_eps v_N1 v_N2
  dsimp only
  intro hN1 hN2
  exact ⟨hN1 (max v_N1 v_N2) (le_max_left v_N1 v_N2), hN2 (max v_N1 v_N2) (le_max_right v_N1 v_N2)⟩

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿明确由三角不等式给出 |L−M|≤|L−aₙ|+|aₙ−M|
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM v_eps v_N1 v_N2
  dsimp only
  exact abs_sub_le v_L (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2)) v_M

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿明确由三角不等式及两个 ε/2 不等式得到 |L−M|<ε
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM v_eps v_N1 v_N2
  dsimp only
  intro htri hboth
  have h1 : abs (v_L - v_a (max v_N1 v_N2)) < v_eps / 2 := by
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    exact hboth.1
  have h2 : abs (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2) - v_M) < v_eps / 2 := hboth.2
  have hsum : abs (v_L - v_a (max v_N1 v_N2)) + abs (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2) - v_M) < v_eps := by
    linarith
  linarith [htri, hsum]

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿明确因此对每个 ε>0 都有 |L−M|<ε
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM h_LM_lt_eps v_eps_forall h_eps_pos
  have hhalf : (0 : ℝ) < v_eps_forall / 2 := by linarith
  rcases (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hL) (v_eps_forall / 2) hhalf with ⟨v_N1, hN1⟩
  rcases (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hM) (v_eps_forall / 2) hhalf with ⟨v_N2, hN2⟩
  have hN1' : abs (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2) - v_L) < v_eps_forall / 2 := by
    have hd : dist (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2)) v_L < v_eps_forall / 2 := hN1 (max v_N1 v_N2) (le_max_left v_N1 v_N2)
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hd
  have hN2' : abs (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2) - v_M) < v_eps_forall / 2 := by
    have hd : dist (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2)) v_M < v_eps_forall / 2 := hN2 (max v_N1 v_N2) (le_max_right v_N1 v_N2)
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hd
  have htri : abs (v_L - v_M) ≤ abs (v_L - v_a (max v_N1 v_N2)) + abs (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2) - v_M) := by
    exact abs_sub_le v_L (v_a (max v_N1 v_N2)) v_M
  exact h_LM_lt_eps v_a v_L v_M hL hM v_eps_forall v_N1 v_N2 htri ⟨hN1', hN2'⟩

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿明确若 |L−M|>0，取 ε=|L−M|/2 将得到矛盾，故 |L−M|=0
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM h_forall_eps
  by_contra hne
  have hpos : 0 < abs (v_L - v_M) := by
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ abs (v_L - v_M) := abs_nonneg _
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg (Ne.symm hne)
  have hhalfpos : 0 < abs (v_L - v_M) / 2 := by linarith
  have hlt : abs (v_L - v_M) < abs (v_L - v_M) / 2 := h_forall_eps (abs (v_L - v_M) / 2) hhalfpos
  linarith

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿明确由 |L−M|=0 推出 L=M
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_a v_L v_M hL hM h_abs_eq_zero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp h_abs_eq_zero)

blocks.text: 设 (aₙ)ₙ∈ℕ 是实数数列，L、M 为实数，已知当 n→∞ 时 aₙ→L 且 aₙ→M。证明 L=M。原证明：任取实数 ε>0。由 aₙ→L 的定义，存在自然数 N₁，使 n≥N₁ 时 |aₙ−L|<ε/2；由 aₙ→M 的定义，存在自然数 N₂，使 n≥N₂ 时 |aₙ−M|<ε/2。取 n=max(N₁,N₂)，则两个不等式同时成立。由三角不等式，|L−M|≤|L−aₙ|+|aₙ−M|<ε。因此对每个 ε>0 都有 |L−M|<ε。若 |L−M|>0，取 ε=|L−M|/2 将得到矛盾，故 |L−M|=0，从而 L=M。证毕。
